Container.Name: storage-node
Container.Overview: Runs storage nodes for Darwin, our decentralised storage network. Each node stores encrypted pieces of uploaded files, proves it still holds them, and earns storage fees in the network's token, paid to your wallet. Run 2 nodes. Each node uses two UDP ports, one for storage and one for web browsers (10000-10001 and 11000-11001 for 2 nodes); see the setup guide (docker/README.md in the darwin-node repository) for forwarding them on your router.

Config.Name: Rewards wallet
Config.Description: Ethereum-style wallet address (0x...) that receives your storage fees.

Config.Name: Number of nodes
Config.Description: How many nodes to run: 2, or 1 on a small machine. The network counts at most 2 nodes per IP address in any close group, so more add load without adding storage. Each node needs at least 20 GB of free disk space (about 35 GB recommended), some memory and CPU, and part of your internet connection.

Config.Name: First UDP port
Config.Description: Nodes use this port and the ones after it. Forward them (UDP) on your router, unless your router has UPnP on: then the nodes open them themselves (see the guide).

Config.Name: First browser UDP port
Config.Description: Each node also serves web browsers on this port and the ones after it. Forward them all (UDP) on your router too, same numbers outside and inside. 0 turns browser access off.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Where node data is stored. The nodes use the free space on the disk this folder is on.

Config.Name: Blockchain RPC
Config.Description: Robinhood Chain RPC the nodes use to check payments. Leave it empty to use the image's free public RPCs; set it to use your own provider's link instead.

Config.Name: IPv4 only
Config.Description: The network runs on IPv4; leave this at true.

Config.Name: Node manager port
Config.Description: Local port (127.0.0.1 only) of the node manager's status page and API. Change it only if something else on the server uses it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the nodes run as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the nodes run as (100 = users on Unraid).
